reviewType: Independent actual-pixel review of the preserved local evidence

findings.location: Bottom transport summary, all five panels
findings.finding: The larger grouped labels are visibly clearer at the inspected 800px teaching width. All named route stages are complete and legible; no clipped glyphs, overlap or missing arrows observed in overview or native detail.

findings.location: Transport panels 2 and 4 and connecting arrows
findings.finding: Straight tubules followed by rete testis is conveyed by the internal downward arrow; epididymal head, body and tail form an internal left-to-right sequence. Between-panel arrows preserve the main route. No false sequence or translation mismatch observed.

findings.location: Anatomical drawing, callouts, leaders, title and notes outside summary
findings.finding: Meaning is retained. Independent XML comparison found all 66 non-summary root children unchanged for each editable and display file.
